page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top left. No margins or notes. Catchword "7. Ex" at the lower right.

main_text.p: hæc verba præcedunt excerpta בחכן כתוב במסרת הר פוס הנון הפוכה וכך רשיובן כתוב בפירו שהתורה המוחס לרבינו שמשון ואנכי וכו ut in libro meo. Cum his verbis habes omnia prorsus qvæ autor in hac materia. Forte [?] ראקי pro [illegible, ~2 letters] תאני vel potius ראקי eo qvod litterarum capita subtilissimis lineolis & spinulis, qvas תנין vocant, coronantur.

6. Ex pag. 320. Nonnihil miror te reprehendere, qvòd eo loco verterim נהוה substitit & dicere vertendum generata est. נתהוה האור significat proprè facta est lux. Sed immediata dixerat ויהי אור & facta est lux, igitur repetendum fuisset & facta est lux. Deinde non fecisset satis hæc interpretatio menti Abarbennelis, qvi non modo contendit, lucem qvalitatem sine corpore factam, sed etiam sine corpore aliqvandiu substitisse. Melius igitur per verbum redditur significans aliqvam status consistentiam. Si interpretemur facta est aut generata, vis sensus minuitur.

page.notes: The boxed glyph in the Hebrew phrase "pro [box] vel potius" is a printed blank, probably a missing Hebrew letter, so it is marked illegible. The Hebrew lines at the top are set small and partly blurred; their letters are copied as far as they can be read, and doubtful letters are marked [?]. Printed spellings such as "qvæ", "qvod", "qvas", "aliqvam" and "Abarbennelis" are kept as printed. The running head is set in small capitals.
